body_html:
Learn Something
2019-10-02 until 2019-11-01

Goal: Learn something new about a passion you have or want to explore.

Objectives:
Define Participatory Learning
Analyze a Connected Learning Environment
Write a collaborative essay
Record a podcast to reflect on your learning

Read:
Pages 1-21. https://www.macfound.org/media/article_pdfs/JENKINS_WHITE_PAPER.PDF
Doug Belshaw The Future of Work
Colin Lankshear The "Stuff" of New Literacies
Castells, M., & Cardoso, G. The Networked Society Read chapters one and two.
Ira Spar Connected Learning Alliance How New Digital Media and the Internet are Fueling an Innovative Surge in Communication, Creativity and Collaboration

Write:
1. Write a blog post about your reactions to the reading.
2. Find a digital essay online and tell us why you love it.
3. Write blog posts reflecting on what you learned and how you learned it.

Participate:
Record four podcast over the course of the module.

Make cycles:
    2-9   Make Cycle Five:  Record two podcasts
    9-16  Make Cycle Six:   Record two podcasts
    12-23 Make Cycle Seven: Digital Essay
    23-30 Make Cycle Eight: Collaborative Essay
